export const meta = {
  name: "grok-shape",
  description: "Reduced toil-block shape for the grok emitter",
  whenToUse: "Fixture only.",
  phases: [
    { title: "Bootstrap", detail: "open a run" },
    { title: "Review", detail: "review axes in rounds" },
  ],
};

const REVIEW_SCHEMA = {
  type: "object",
  required: ["status"],
  properties: {
    status: { type: "string", enum: ["ok", "abort"] },
  },
};

// `await agent()` in a comment is not a call site.
async function dispatchOne(options) {
  const first = await agent(options.prompt, {
    agentType: "tl-runner",
    phase: "Bootstrap",
    label: options.label,
    schema: REVIEW_SCHEMA,
  });
  return first;
}

phase("Bootstrap");
const axis = "a11y";
const topic = args.topic ?? "toil";
const maxRounds = args.maxRounds ?? 2;

const opened = await dispatchOne({
  prompt: "Open the run.",
  agentType: "tl-runner",
  phase: "Bootstrap",
  label: "open",
  runnerType: "tl-runner",
  schema: REVIEW_SCHEMA,
});

let round = 0;
while (round < maxRounds) {
  phase("Review");
  const axes = await parallel([
    () => agent(`Review ${axis} for ${topic}.`, {
      agentType: "readonly-reviewer",
      phase: "Review",
      label: `review:${axis}`,
      schema: REVIEW_SCHEMA,
    }),
    () => agent("Second check", {
      agentType: "tl-runner",
      phase: "Review",
      label: "second",
      schema: REVIEW_SCHEMA,
    }),
  ]);
  round += 1;
}

const report = await agent("Write the report.", {
  agentType: "tl-reporter",
  phase: "Review",
  label: "report",
  schema: REVIEW_SCHEMA,
});

return { opened, report };
